records.jp: あっ、愛央ちゃんだ！<CR>ねえねえ、今って時間あるかな？
records.en_original: Oh, hi Ao! Hey, do you have a minute?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, hi Ao! Hey, do you have a minute?
records.en: Ah, it's Ao-chan!<CR>Hey, hey, do you have a minute right now?

records.jp: うん、大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: Sure, of course.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, of course.
records.en: Yeah, I do.

records.jp: やった～！　じゃあ早速中庭に行こ！<CR>一緒にやって欲しいことがあるんだ
records.en_original: Yay! Follow me to the courtyard! I have something I want your help with.
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! Follow me to the courtyard! I have something I want your help with.
records.en: Yay! Then let's head to the courtyard right away!<CR>There's something I want you to do with me.

records.jp: 一緒にやって欲しいことって、掃除だったんだ
records.en_original: So you wanted help with cleaning, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: So you wanted help with cleaning, huh?
records.en: So the thing you wanted me to do with you was cleaning?

records.jp: えへへ……手伝ってくれてありがとう、愛央ちゃん。<CR>すっごく助かっちゃった！
records.en_original: Hehe... Thanks for coming. I really appreciate the help!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... Thanks for coming. I really appreciate the help!
records.en: Ehehe... Thanks for helping, Ao-chan.<CR>You really saved me!

records.jp: 最近いつの間にかいろんなところが綺麗になってると<CR>思ったら……もしかして陽桜莉さんがやってたの？
records.en_original: I did notice a lot of places around the school are a lot tidier than usual lately. Was that all you?
records.en_auxiliary: I did notice a lot of places around the school are a lot tidier than usual lately. Was that all you?
records.en: I was wondering why all sorts of places had gotten neat and tidy<CR>before I knew it... Was that you, Hiori-san?

records.jp: まあね！　みんな喜んでくれるかなーって思って
records.en_original: Yep! I thought it might make everybody happy.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep! I thought it might make everybody happy.
records.en: Pretty much! I thought everyone might be happy.

records.jp: あっ、いたいた。<CR>陽桜莉さーん。おにぎり、準備できましたよー
records.en_original: Oh, there she is. Hiori! I've brought you some rice balls!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, there she is. Hiori! I've brought you some rice balls!
records.en: Ah, there you are.<CR>Hiori-saan, the onigiri are ready.

records.jp: わ、本当に作ってくれたの？<CR>ありがとー！
records.en_original: You really made me some?! Thank you!
records.en_auxiliary: You really made me some?! Thank you!
records.en: Wow, you really made them for me?<CR>Thank you!

records.jp: 詩帆さん？　それに、おにぎりって……？
records.en_original: Hey, Shiho. What's with the rice balls?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Shiho. What's with the rice balls?
records.en: Shiho-san? And onigiri...?

records.jp: この前、陽桜莉さんが力仕事を手伝ってくれて……。<CR>そのお礼におにぎりを作るって約束してたんです
records.en_original: Hiori helped me with a little heavy lifting the other day, so I promised I'd make her some as thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori helped me with a little heavy lifting the other day, so I promised I'd make her some as thanks.
records.en: The other day, Hiori-san helped me with some heavy work...<CR>So I promised I'd make her onigiri as thanks.

records.jp: たくさん作ったので、よかったら星崎さんもどうですか？
records.en_original: I actually made more than I meant to, would you like some too?
records.en_auxiliary: I actually made more than I meant to, would you like some too?
records.en: I made a lot, so if you'd like, Hoshizaki-san, would you like some too?

records.jp: おお～っ！　ありがとう！<CR>ちょうどお腹空いたな～って思ってたとこなんだ
records.en_original: Ooh, thanks! I was just starting to feel hungry.
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, thanks! I was just starting to feel hungry.
records.en: Ooh! Thanks!<CR>I was just thinking I was getting hungry.

records.jp: たくさん作って、大変じゃなかった？<CR>また今度何か手伝ってお返しするね
records.en_original: It must've taken you a long time to make all this, right? Let me know if you need any more help so I can repay you.
records.en_auxiliary: It must've taken you a long time to make all this, right? Let me know if you need any more help so I can repay you.
records.en: Wasn't it a lot of work to make so many?<CR>I'll help you with something next time to repay you.

records.jp: ええっ！　そしたら、わたしもまたお返ししないと……
records.en_original: What! But then I'd have to repay you again as well...
records.en_auxiliary: What! But then I'd have to repay you again as well...
records.en: What!? Then I'd have to repay you again...

records.jp: あはは、お返しスパイラルだ！
records.en_original: Haha, an endless loop of favors!
records.en_auxiliary: Haha, an endless loop of favors!
records.en: Ahaha, a repayment spiral!

records.jp: なるほど、お手伝いしたらお返しが貰える……
records.en_original: Hm... So if you help someone, they have to do something for you, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... So if you help someone, they have to do something for you, huh?
records.en: I see, if you help someone, you get repaid...

records.jp: ということは、今日は陽桜莉さんを手伝ったから、<CR>陽桜莉さんに何かお返しをねだれる……？
records.en_original: Do I get to request a favor since I helped out today?
records.en_auxiliary: Do I get to request a favor since I helped out today?
records.en: Which means, since I helped Hiori-san today,<CR>I can demand something from Hiori-san in return...?

records.jp: おー、確かに？<CR>愛央ちゃん、何してほしい？
records.en_original: I think you do! What I can do for you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: I think you do! What I can do for you, Ao?
records.en: Oh, true?<CR>Ao-chan, what do you want me to do?

records.jp: 何をお願いしようかなー。<CR>せっかく陽桜莉さんを好き勝手にできるからなー
records.en_original: Hm... I can ask for anything I want, right? So many choices...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... I can ask for anything I want, right? So many choices...
records.en: What should I ask for?<CR>I do get to have my way with Hiori-san for once...

records.jp: え……？　好き勝手……？
records.en_original: A-anything...?
records.en_auxiliary: A-anything...?
records.en: Ehh...? Have your way with...?

records.jp: 私思ってたんだ。<CR>陽桜莉さんには猫耳が似合うんじゃないかって
records.en_original: I've always thought you'd look cute with some cat ears...
records.en_auxiliary: I've always thought you'd look cute with some cat ears...
records.en: I've always thought this.<CR>That cat ears would suit you, Hiori-san.

records.jp: 明日一日猫耳つけて、語尾に「にゃん」を付けて<CR>もらおうかなー？
records.en_original: So maybe I'll have you act like a cat all tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: So maybe I'll have you act like a cat all tomorrow.
records.en: Maybe I'll have you wear cat ears all day tomorrow,<CR>and end every sentence with "meow"?

records.jp: えー！？
records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?!
records.en: Eeh!?

records.jp: うう、でも仕方ないかな……手伝ってもらったんだし
records.en_original: Aww... I guess I don't have much of a choice... You did help me after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Aww... I guess I don't have much of a choice... You did help me after all.
records.en: Uuugh, but I guess it can't be helped... You did help me.

records.jp: うん、やるよ！<CR>私は明日、猫になる！
records.en_original: All right, I'll do it! I'll be a cat for a day!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, I'll do it! I'll be a cat for a day!
records.en: Yeah, I'll do it!<CR>Tomorrow, I'll become a cat!

records.jp: ぷっ……あはは。<CR>星崎さん、あまり陽桜莉さんを困らせちゃだめですよ
records.en_original: Pff... Hahaha! Come on Ao, don't tease Hiori so much.
records.en_auxiliary: Pff... Hahaha! Come on Ao, don't tease Hiori so much.
records.en: Pfft... Ahaha.<CR>Hoshizaki-san, you mustn't trouble Hiori-san too much.

records.jp: えっ？　えっ？
records.en_original: Wha—huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—huh?
records.en: Huh? Huh?

records.jp: ごめんごめん。<CR>陽桜莉さん、冗談だよ
records.en_original: Sorry, Hiori. I was just joking.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, Hiori. I was just joking.
records.en: Sorry, sorry.<CR>Hiori-san, I was kidding.

records.jp: 手伝ったお返しは、このおにぎりのおすそ分けで<CR>十分だから
records.en_original: These rice balls are more than enough for me.
records.en_auxiliary: These rice balls are more than enough for me.
records.en: Sharing these onigiri you were given<CR>is more than enough repayment.

records.jp: 冗談！？<CR>もー、せっかく覚悟したのに！
records.en_original: Just joking?! I was totally ready to do it!
records.en_auxiliary: Just joking?! I was totally ready to do it!
records.en: A joke!?<CR>Geez, I finally got myself ready for it!

records.jp: あはは
records.en_original: Ahaha.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha.
records.en: Ahaha.

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんは、とってもまっすぐな人だ）
records.en_original: (Hiori sure is sincere.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hiori sure is sincere.)
records.en: (Hiori-san is a very straightforward person.)

records.jp: （良いと思ったことを率先して実行する。<CR>見返りも求めずに）
records.en_original: (She'll do anything she thinks is right without expecting anything in return.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She'll do anything she thinks is right without expecting anything in return.)
records.en: (She takes the initiative to do what she thinks is right.<CR>Without asking for anything in return.)

records.jp: （それに人を疑ったりしない。<CR>みんなのことを心から信じてる）
records.en_original: (And she trusts everyone from the bottom of her heart.)
records.en_auxiliary: (And she trusts everyone from the bottom of her heart.)
records.en: (And she doesn't doubt people.<CR>She believes in everyone from the bottom of her heart.)

records.jp: （だから、陽桜莉さんはみんなをよく頼り……<CR>そして、そんな陽桜莉さんをみんなも頼る）
records.en_original: (That's why she can rely on everyone when she needs it and other people feel like they can rely on her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's why she can rely on everyone when she needs it and other people feel like they can rely on her.)
records.en: (That's why Hiori-san often relies on everyone...<CR>and those same people rely on Hiori-san too.)

records.jp: （こういう人のところに、人は集まるんだろうなって<CR>思える）
records.en_original: (I think people really gravitate toward people like her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think people really gravitate toward people like her.)
records.en: (It makes me feel like people must naturally gather around<CR>someone like her.)

records.jp: （なんだか……眩しいな）
records.en_original: (She's...radiant.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's...radiant.)
records.en: (She's somehow... dazzling.)

records.jp: ねえ、ホウキ出しっぱなしにしてるの、誰？
records.en_original: Who left the brooms out?
records.en_auxiliary: Who left the brooms out?
records.en: Hey, who left the brooms out?

records.jp: あ
records.en_original: Ohh...
records.en_auxiliary: Ohh...
records.en: Ah.

records.jp: （……ちょっと抜けてるところもあるけどね）
records.en_original: (...Though she can be pretty forgetful too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...Though she can be pretty forgetful too.)
records.en: (...Though she can be a little absentminded too.)

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>鬼盛りスペシャル<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Mega Size Special<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Mega Size Special<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Mega Size Special<CLNR> memory.
